meta_description: Scott Gardening in Leicester offers reliable garden maintenance, landscaping and seasonal work. Local gardener serving LE4 and surrounding areas. Call 07376 327534.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to full garden transformations, Scott delivers reliable landscaping and maintenance across Leicester.
services_subhead: Scott handles everything from regular maintenance to complete garden redesigns, using proven techniques and quality materials.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Upkeep
services.desc: Regular lawn cutting, hedge trimming, and seasonal tidying to keep your garden looking sharp year-round. Fortnightly or monthly visits tailored to your needs.

services.title: Landscaping & Garden Design
services.desc: Transform an overgrown or tired garden into a space you'll love. Scott designs and builds patios, raised beds, borders, and pathways suited to your home.

services.title: Lawn Care & Renovation
services.desc: Scarifying, aeration, seeding, and moss control to restore tired lawns. Includes expert advice on feeding and seasonal care.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Work
services.desc: Professional trimming, shaping, and removal of trees and hedges. Safe, tidy work with waste responsibly cleared.

services.title: Spring & Autumn Clearance
services.desc: Deep cleans and seasonal prep: leaf collection, dead-heading, border clearing, and mulching to prepare your garden for the months ahead.

services.title: Patio & Driveway Cleaning
services.desc: Pressure washing and manual cleaning to restore patios and driveways. Removes algae, moss, and grime without damage to surfaces.

about_pullquote: A well-kept garden shouldn't cost a fortune or demand stress.
about_para_1: Scott started out 15 years ago because he loved creating outdoor spaces that homeowners could be proud of. What began as one person with a van has grown into a trusted name across Leicester, known for reliable, honest work and fair pricing. Scott turns up on time, gets the job done properly, and always clears up after himself.
about_para_2: His customers value that he listens to what you want, suggests practical solutions, and treats your garden like it matters—because it does. Whether you need a one-off tidy or ongoing maintenance, Scott builds long-term relationships with clients across LE4 and beyond. Repeat work and word-of-mouth referrals speak volumes.

reviews.text: Scott transformed our jungle of a back garden into somewhere we actually want to spend time. He was on time, worked hard, cleared everything up, and charged a fair price. Dead impressed. Will have him back for regular maintenance.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using Scott for hedge trimming and lawn care for three years now. Reliable, friendly, and knows what he's doing. Never once let me down. Highly recommend if you're in Leicester.
reviews.author: Helen P.

reviews.text: Needed the patio cleaned and the borders sorted before we sold. Scott did both brilliantly, turned up when he said he would, and the work was spot on. Top job.
reviews.author: James M.
